verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMUKWANO gwa Yesu
Tegutegeerekeka;
Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
Y'anjigiriza yekka;
Emirembe gijuza
Bwe gityo-omwoyo gwange,
Era gikulukuta Bulijjo-okunsanyusa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Byonna-ebitalabika
Kaakano mbirengedde;
Bibikkuliddwa gye ndi
Ku lw'ekisa kya Yesu;
Era-ebinafu by'ensi
Katonda yabironda,
Alyoke-akwase-ensonyi
Eby'amaanyi mangi nnyo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Eby'entiisa sibitya;
Nvumbudde-ekiwummulo;
Sikyayengetana,so
Sikyataagana nate.
Nnina-ennono y'obulamu,
Kwe kukkiriza Yesu,
Era nnyimba n'essanyu
Ye Mulokozi wange.
